name: alert-noise-classifier
description: Classifies a list of fired alerts you paste into the chat (an incident-tool CSV export, Alertmanager or Grafana webhook JSON, an alert-bot chat paste, or plain lines with a time and an alert name) as actionable, noise or unclear. Each verdict carries a reason built from counts and durations computed in code: fires auto-resolved in under 5 minutes, acknowledged with no action, flapping, periodic, or a storm child of another alert. Weak evidence goes to unclear, never to noise. It then suggests tuning (a for: value, routing to a ticket, inhibiting, retiring) with its assumption and how many pages it would have saved. Follow-ups: only noise, only <alert>, why is <alert> noise, show the numbers, top 3 to fix, what if for = 10m, as json. It judges what fired, not the rule definitions; it reads only what you paste, watches nothing and changes nothing; no general questions.

skills.name: Classify alert noise
skills.description: Actionable, noise and unclear alerts from a pasted list of fired alerts, with code-computed reasons, tuning suggestions with assumptions and pages saved, plus follow-ups on the same classification.
examples: Which of these alerts are noise? <paste the alerts>
Classify last week's pages: <paste the export>
